help: read, through Safari, which chats a provider's account holds and how far each has gone, and record it at fetch/<provider>/chat/listing.json - so that a bare corpus-yoga browser says which chats are new or have grown since their capture without sending; claude's is one read of the chat list, gemini's opens every captured chat the account's listing still shows

args.name: --provider
args.help: the account to read, claude or gemini
